claim: The scaled dot-product attention formula is calculated as softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k)) V.
The Transformer base model uses 8 parallel attention heads with a dimension of 64 for each head.
The encoder stack consists of N = 6 identical layers, each containing a multi-head self-attention sub-layer and a position-wise feed-forward sub-layer.
Positional encodings are added to the input embeddings using sine and cosine functions of different frequencies.
The Transformer model relies on recurrent neural networks (RNNs) to process temporal sequential structure.
The base Transformer model was trained using 32 NVIDIA A100 GPUs for a duration of two weeks.
The scaling factor 1 / sqrt(d_k) is applied to keep the dot products small and avoid pushing the softmax function into regions with tiny gradients.
FlashAttention GPU kernel optimizations were proposed in this paper to accelerate matrix multiplication.
The decoder prevents positions from attending to subsequent positions using masked multi-head attention.
The model achieved a BLEU score of 28.4 on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task.
